name: MPM Simulation Verification Provenance
goal: Identify scholarly methods and evidence for verification, validation, uncertainty quantification, reproducibility, provenance and automated consistency checking in MPM and related particle-based fluid-rigid simulations. Prioritise studies that test parameter wiring, mass, inertia and centre-of-gravity consistency, geometry and bounding-box fidelity, friction and gravity definitions, resolution convergence, free-surface water coupling, traction, buoyancy, stability, code-to-code or experiment comparison, and run-manifest traceability. IDENTIFY CONCRETE GATES AND DIAGNOSTICS SUITABLE FOR CI OR PRE-COMMIT ENFORCEMENT.
summary:
For a 36-condition flooded-road vehicle sweep, the strongest evidence chain combines full-scale force, traction, friction and buoyancy measurements [Smi19] with experimentally benchmarked free-surface particle simulations [Sun19c, Li14] and automated verification and regression controls [Bra11, Zha23i].

PHYSICAL VALIDATION, highest for vehicle conclusions: [Smi19] directly measures prototype traction and drag across bed conditions; [Alq21] supplies full-scale response data; [Azh23] validates SPH stability criteria against laboratory measurements. VEHICLE-MODEL DISAGREEMENT AND THRESHOLD SPREAD ARE THEMSELVES MODEL-FORM UNCERTAINTY [Boc19].
NUMERICAL VERIFICATION, highest implementation relevance: patch, frame and basis-indifference, manufactured-solution, traction, convergence and large-deformation tests [Bra11, Kam06, Kam13]. MPM-specific risks: basis and boundary choices [Ste08], critical timestep instability [Ni20, Bai22], quadrature and grid-crossing error [Ste00], energy drift [Bar02].
UQ: report discretisation uncertainty using refinement studies [Cel07, Roa94], and COMBINE numerical, experimental, parameter and model-form uncertainty RATHER THAN TREATING VALIDATION AS PASS/FAIL [Ste01, Eca20, Rie20].
CI AND PROVENANCE: enforce schema and unit normalisation and setup visualisation [Mcd14]; record code, inputs, environment, hashes, outputs and analysis lineage [Hub20, Dhr23]. PRE-COMMIT GATES SHOULD CHECK mass/inertia/CoG, geometry and bounding boxes, gravity and friction, particle counts, timestep and CFL, conservation residuals, resolution convergence, free-surface/traction/buoyancy diagnostics, and manifest completeness; regression tolerances should accommodate parallel and physical variability [Zha23i].
